name: Maple
description: Maple Finance is an institutional capital marketplace powered by blockchain technology.

methodology.Fees: Total interest and fees paid by borrowers on both fixed-term and open-term loans, including net interest, management fees, service fees, strategy fees and origination fees, plus off-chain OTC desk revenue.
methodology.Revenue: Total revenue flowing to Maple protocol and delegates, including management fees, service fees, strategy fees and origination fees from both fixed-term and open-term loans.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue flowing to Maple protocol treasuries, i.e. total revenue less the share allocated to SYRUP buybacks.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Net interest earned by liquidity providers/depositors in Maple pools from both fixed-term and open-term loan payments, after the management fee the pool takes out of that interest.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of revenue used to buy back SYRUP tokens: 20% from Jan 2025 (MIP-013/016), 25% from Jul 2025 (MIP-019), and from Jul 2026 10%, 20% or 30% of each month's revenue for months under $1.5M, $1.5M-$2M or above $2M (MIP-021).

Fees.Borrow Interest: Net interest paid by borrowers on open-term loans.
Fees.Management Fees: Management fees from open-term and fixed-term loans, origination fees from fixed-term loans, and off-chain OTC desk revenue, paid to protocol and delegates.
Fees.Service Fees: Service fees from both fixed-term and open-term loans, paid to protocol and delegates.
Fees.Strategy Fees: Aave/sky Strategy fees paid to protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: Interest distributed to liquidity providers, net of the management fee taken out of it.

Revenue.Management Fees: Management fees from open-term loans and origination fees from fixed-term loans.
Revenue.Service Fees: Service fees from both fixed-term and open-term loans.
Revenue.Strategy Fees: Aave/sky Strategy fees paid to protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Management Fees: Management fees share to Maple protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Service Fees: Service fees share to Maple protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Strategy Fees: Aave/sky Strategy fees share to Maple protocol.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Share of revenue used for SYRUP token buybacks: 20% from Jan 2025, 25% from Jul 2025 (MIP-019), and from Jul 2026 10%/20%/30% of monthly revenue under $1.5M, $1.5M-$2M and above $2M (MIP-021).
